adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `offset = params[:offset].to_i` are passed directly into `group.users...limit(limit).offset(offset)` with no validation/clamping. A client can supply a huge `limit` (or `limit=-1`, which in PostgreSQL effectively removes the limit) to bypass pagination, and a negative `offset` can reach SQL where negative OFFSET is invalid and can trigger a 500 on this public endpoint.
